title: SaveResult
description: What save_group_changes returns (specs/COMMUNITY.md 5.4): ok, or every problem keyed to its field or row, with nothing saved.

ok.description: True when every change was saved; false when none was.

field_errors.description: Edit field id to the backend's message, shown under that field.

row_errors.description: User id to the backend's message, shown on that person's row.
